thesis: GMAB is a post-spike fade in a confirmed risk-off tape. The Oct 28 gap-and-run has no identified catalyst, and since 11/9 the stock has made lower highs and lower closes, now sitting on SMA20 with the pre-market quote below the close. Insiders, including the CEO, sold into the spike. The stop is tight relative to ATR, so noise stop-outs are likely. If SMA20 and the 50.68 swing low fail, the technical card itself points to a gap-fill toward 44-45. Buying a fading, unexplained spike while QQQ is below its 200-day and VIX is elevated is poor timing.
